study type: Laboratory study using human tissue samples (fibroblasts)
outcome: inhibitory effect of progesterone on lipopolysaccharide-induced inflammatory stimuli
cohort: The study used primary cultures of human uterine cervical fibroblasts obtained from patients with refractory innate cervical insufficiency and control patients undergoing elective caesarean section.
finding: The progesterone response, progesterone receptor expression, and the inhibitory effect of progesterone on lipopolysaccharide-induced inflammatory stimuli were all impaired in cervical fibroblasts from patients with cervical insufficiency compared to controls.
